blocked_checks.note: 403 on opening; accessible PharmEasy page used instead.

fasting_policy: Values describe the cited standalone test or specified provider panel. Unknown means optional, variable, or not explicitly established. Co-ordered tests and the booking lab may change preparation.
scope: Parchi prescription-name normalization: 25 requested tests plus four common additional tests; fasting flags describe cited protocols, not universal booking instructions.

sources.proves: CBC alternative names, contents, and usual absence of special preparation.
HbA1c alternative names and distinction from a single glucose measurement.
Fasting and random glucose names; fasting glucose requires at least eight hours; random glucose and HbA1c do not require fasting.
Lipid profile/panel names and conditional fasting protocol.
Free and total T3 names, distinct analytes, and preparation.
Free and total T4 names, distinct analytes, and preparation.
TSH/thyrotropin names and preparation section.
LFT/liver panel synonyms, component tests, and conditional fasting.
Vitamin B12/cobalamin names and conditional fasting for blood vitamin tests.
25-hydroxyvitamin D names, distinction from active vitamin D, and preparation.
Serum/blood creatinine names, distinction from urine creatinine/eGFR, and conditional preparation.
Serum urate/UA names and distinction between blood and urine tests.
Total versus ionized calcium distinction and preparation.
ESR alternative names and absence of special preparation for the standalone test.
CRP name and explicit distinction from high-sensitivity CRP.
Hb/Hgb names, distinction from HbA1c, and preparation.
HCT/PCV/packed cell volume names and preparation.
Platelet count versus platelet function tests; no special preparation for a count.
Separate iron, transferrin, TIBC and ferritin assays; fasting may be requested.
eAG is calculated from HbA1c rather than an independent synonym for the assay.
Kidney function test/KFT and kidney panel naming; this provider page requires no special preparation.
Total thyroid panel contains total T3, total T4 and TSH; no fasting required on this provider page.
Separate fasting and two-hour post-meal glucose components; PP name and meal timing.
Urine routine/analysis/microscopy naming and no-fasting statement.
Serum uric acid name and no-special-preparation statement.
CRP quantitative name and explicit no-fasting prerequisite.
Dengue NS1 antigen EIA assay name and no-special-preparation statement.
Widal slide agglutination name, tube/slide distinction, no-fasting statement.
Iron studies panel name; overnight fasting and sampling before noon are preferred, rather than stated mandatory.
Urine culture/aerobic bacterial culture and sensitivity menu name; fasting not required.
Official Lal brochure separately names NS1 antigen, dengue IgG/IgM antibody and qualitative PCR tests; supports avoiding assay substitution.
